definition.description: From a seated position on a clean stable floor or mat, put both palms behind the hips with fingers forward or slightly outward and both feet fixed with knees bent to approximately 90 degrees. Lift hips into a table shape with controlled shoulders, open chest, straight or nearly straight arms, and no wrist collapse. Count only continuous valid hold seconds; lower hips under control to exit. Finger direction, hand spacing, knee angle within the declared bent-knee table range, breath, hold seconds, rest, mat use, and cueing are delivery annotations. Straight-leg reverse planks, crab walks, bridges, hip thrusts, limb lifts, moving tasks, raised or unstable support, external load, assessments, and clinical interventions require their own reviewed definition or variant.
